hook: Your planet left a message on the Moon.
title: A Coin-Sized Disc of Messages Sits on the Moon
description:
Apollo 11 left a small silicon disc on the Moon in 1969. It carries goodwill messages from 73 countries, shrunk to microscopic size.

Series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #Apollo11
comment_prompt: Would you read it? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your planet left a message on the Moon.
scenes.headline: MESSAGE ON THE MOON

scenes.narration: Apollo 11 left a small silicon disc there.
scenes.headline: SILICON DISC

scenes.narration: It is about the size of a coin.
scenes.headline: COIN-SIZED

scenes.narration: It holds goodwill messages from seventy-three countries.
scenes.headline: 73 COUNTRIES

scenes.narration: The messages were shrunk to microscopic size.
scenes.headline: MICROSCOPIC TEXT

scenes.narration: It was left behind with the lander.
scenes.headline: LEFT WITH LANDER

scenes.narration: So your planet's words still sit on the Moon.
scenes.headline: STILL THERE

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: rockets fire right before a landing.
scenes.headline: NEXT: SOYUZ
